authentication.notice: Authentication is not enforced yet. The Python backend will require an API key on every request once it ships — this reference already reflects that contract so integration work can start now.

statusCodes.label: OK
statusCodes.description: The request succeeded and the response contains the requested data.

statusCodes.label: Bad Request
statusCodes.description: The request was malformed or missing a required parameter.

statusCodes.label: Unauthorized
statusCodes.description: The API key was missing or invalid.

statusCodes.label: Too Many Requests
statusCodes.description: The request was rate limited for the current plan.

statusCodes.label: Internal Server Error
statusCodes.description: Something went wrong while processing the request.
